parsed.title: Inconsistent versioning type for re-bundle
parsed.detail: The entry for `@gtrabanco/pi-agentic-workflow` version 0.10.0 is marked as 'menor' (minor), but the description states it is a 'Re-empaquetado' (re-bundle) that includes multiple version bumps for several skills (e.g., `review-change` 3.5.1 is a patch, `plan-feature` 5.2.0 is minor). While the package itself has no code changes, the description of the change as a 're-bundle' of multiple versioned components contradicts the single 'menor' classification if the intent is to reflect the actual delta of the constituent skills being released together.
